scripts.lint: tsc -p frontend/tsconfig.json --noEmit && cargo fmt --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: vitest run --config frontend/vite.config.ts && cargo test --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml && node frontend/e2e/restart-persistence.mjs && node frontend/e2e/smoke.mjs
